chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Hariz, from Fuzayl ibn Yasar, said:

Indeed, the Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the Ziyarah of the graves of the martyrs, and the Ziyarah of the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equate to having performed a Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.زِيَارَة: Visitation or pilgrimage to a holy site or grave
key_terms.قَبْر رَسُول اللَّهِ: The grave of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the profound spiritual merit of Ziyarah, equating visits to the Prophet, martyrs, and Imam Al-Husayn with the reward of Hajj with the Prophet. In Shia tradition, this highlights the continuity of spiritual connection through physical presence at sacred sites, reinforcing the status of the Ahl al-Bayt as intercessors and guides. The comparison to Hajj emphasizes that these visits are not merely commemorative but act as significant acts of worship that draw the believer closer to divine grace.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Hareyz, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar,
Heasws said, ‘The Ziyarah of the grave of Rasool-Allahsaww, and Ziyarah of the martyrs, and Ziyarah of the grave of Al-Husaynasws equates to having performed a Hajj with Rasool-Allahsaww’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Hariz from Fudayl ibn Yasar who (in a Mawquf manner) has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam has said, ‘

Visiting the grave of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, the graves of the martyrs and the grave of Imam al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, is equal to performing al-Hajj along with the Messenger of Allah.”
